## Description

Pilot R2 on flags; evidence for: ≥ 20 real visits per pilot doctor signed in Medvya; allergy/interaction seeded tests 100 %; signed-note immutability test; each doctor's Rx layout approval. Clinical safety reviewer signs the release. R2 release notes and known-issues list. Journey steps for J1/J2/J3 without AI turn green.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Evidence for all four exit criteria attached and confirmed at the exit gate review.
- [ ] **AC2.** Clinical safety reviewer sign-off recorded for R2.
- [ ] **AC3.** R2 release notes list P2-01…P2-08 status and exclusions (AI drafting, billing, results inbox, regulator e-prescription).
- [ ] **AC4.** Playwright journeys J2/J3 pass for the non-AI path (consent declined/manual note).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
